# Extract away team scores and convert to numeric total points
# The score format is like "9.11 (65)" where the number in parentheses is total points
# We'll extract the total points from the away team score column
df['away_total'] = df['away team score'].str.extract(r'\((\d+)\)').astype(int)

# Get unique away teams
unique_away_teams = df['away team'].unique()

# Count how many unique away teams have at least one game with away_total > 10
away_teams_gt_10 = df[df['away_total'] > 10]['away team'].unique()
count_gt_10 = len(away_teams_gt_10)
total_unique = len(unique_away_teams)

# Check if exactly 1/3 of unique away teams satisfy the condition
answer = (count_gt_10 / total_unique) == (1 / 3)
~~~
